documents.why: Posted straight to 1100 Accounts Receivable by a journal entry that names no customer, so no customer's balance carries it; move it to an invoice or a credit memo.

rows.name: A/R Aging = Accounts Receivable
rows.sentence: The A/R Aging total is $134.40 and 1100 Accounts Receivable is $214.40, $80.00 apart. Look at the documents below: an invoice whose balance due drifted from what was paid and credited on it, or an entry posted straight to the account (a journal entry, a job cost entry) that names no customer, which no customer's balance carries. The Journal checks further down name a voided document still posting and a posted invoice with no journal entry.
